outcome: Maternal or fetal signs of infection (chorioamnionitis, early neonatal sepsis, postpartum endometritis)
cohort: 325 patients with term PROM, with 213 managed expectantly and 112 induced at admission
finding: Expectant management of term PROM was associated with a higher likelihood of cesarean delivery and prolonged maternal hospitalization compared to induced labor management.
mod_finding: The study found that expectant management of term PROM, compared to labor induction, was associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery.
